utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m thinking we should go sooner rather than later if it’s likely to get busy. Do I need to drop anything off before it gets crowded?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good point—Dane said to check the sign-up sheet first, so let’s do that before we head over. If it looks busy, we can still go early and drop things off then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds safest—I’ll check the sign-up sheet first, and if it’s filling up, we should go early and drop things off then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll set aside a hammer and a few screwdrivers for Noah and bring them by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nice, that helps. I’ll share the drop-off window as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—just send me the drop-off window and I’ll bring the tools over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara’s checking what tools she can bring and she’ll help spread the word, too. Bo’s got a few hand tools and gloves, and Pia’s still sorting out the timing and whether to drop things off early.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, that’s helpful — I’ll keep spreading the word and keep everyone updated on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an ear out for any timing updates from Pia and let you know if I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sam and Bo are helping with the repair drive, and Rosa’s keeping it organized. Vik’s spreading the word and keeping everyone updated on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there for the repair drive. Thanks for keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Uli — glad you can make it. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make sure both friend groups hear the details and know to come by. It’s a great way for everyone to help out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll bring a few hand tools and gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll pass that along to both groups and let everyone know you’re bringing tools and gloves. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Gus is bringing the tools over on Saturday to get things moving. Bo’s also bringing a few hand tools and gloves, and Gus set aside a hammer and some screwdrivers for Noah.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good to know — I’ve got work gloves and a hammer ready too. If you hear anything else about the drive, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’m just passing along what I hear, so I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m bringing a wrench set and some spare screwdrivers, and I’ll check the west side of the repair tent for any loose boxes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Sam. I’ll make a quick list for Gus and get it to him.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli. I’ll head over Sunday at the community center and keep an eye on those boxes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll swing by late on Sunday at the community center and help for a bit. I’ll also spread the word in case anyone’s missed it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — that helps a lot. I’m free around school drop-off and pickup, so Mara can match me to whatever time works best.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll catch up late on Sunday and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got Bo, Sam, and Uli on the invite list, and Mara said she’ll see what tools she can bring. I’ll spread the word fast so everyone knows about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good—if you’ve got Bo, Sam, and Uli covered, the repair drive should be easy to find. I’ll keep track of who’s heading there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll keep nudging folks so the word gets around. Thanks for keeping track—I’ll let you know if anyone else gets added.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard Quinn and Vik are still spreading the word about the repair drive, and Dane said he can help for a bit on Saturday. I'll keep an ear out for any more updates while I'm out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I’m still catching up, so I’ll watch for Leo’s updated details and the drop-off window. Once I’ve got that, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out, and I’ll pass along anything I hear about Leo’s details or the drop-off window.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can spread the word and see what tools I can bring for the repair drive. Gus is bringing the hammer and screwdrivers by, so we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That helps a lot. We still need more volunteers for the Saturday shifts, so I’ll keep asking around.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll ask a few more neighbors too and keep an eye out for anyone who can take a Saturday shift.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Bo and Sam are helping with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep — Bo’s bringing some hand tools and gloves, and I can help sort the donations and load a few boxes. I might be a little scatterbrained, but I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so Sam is helping too, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara said she’ll spread the word and see what tools she can bring, and Bo’s bringing a few hand tools plus gloves. Pia’s still sorting out the timing and whether to drop things off before it gets crowded.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great — I’ll be here this afternoon to log everything, and I’m expecting Cleo’s screws and tape plus Rey’s gloves and hammer. Sunday at the community center is still the plan, so we’re in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like we’re in good shape then — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything else that comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need more volunteers for the Saturday shifts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can sort the donations and carry a few boxes for the repair drive. Just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thank you. Can you help with the Saturday shifts too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should go sooner if we can, before it gets crowded. Do I need to drop anything off first, or is Rosa all set?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Rosa should be all set. I’m bringing some tools for the repair drive, and Noah said we still need a hammer and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, then I’ll try to come sooner. I can drop off a hammer and a few screwdrivers before it gets busy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa’s got the repair drive organized, so we should follow her plan. Bo, Sam, and Vik are all helping too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and share any news I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that’ll help a lot. Keep me posted if you hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word to both groups and encourage everyone to swing by. I’ll also point folks to the tools-and-parts list so they know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — I can help with the repair drive, and I’ll see what tools I can bring too. I’ll also spread the word on my end.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Mara — thank you. I’ll make sure both groups hear the details and know where to find the tools-and-parts list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll be at the community center on Sunday with a wrench set and some spare screwdrivers. I’m also checking the west side of the repair tent for any loose boxes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Sam — I’ll keep an ear out for the drop-off window and pass along anything Leo sends. Once I’ve got the updated details, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Noah — that helps a lot. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and will keep an eye on the west side of the repair tent.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I’ll swing by late and help for a bit. I’ll also spread the word so more folks know to come by Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — that’ll help a lot. If you can, point folks to the community center on Sunday so they know where to head.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll point everyone to the community center on Sunday and catch up late to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll check the sign-up sheet first before I do anything. And it’s good to know Jules will keep both groups updated about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve got my work gloves and hammer ready. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect, thanks Rey. I’ll keep an eye on the sign-up sheet and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll bring a few hand tools and gloves for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — that helps a lot. I can pitch in around school drop-off or pickup if that makes the timing easier.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that might help if the timing gets tight. I’ll keep you posted if I need a school-run hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so Quinn will make sure Uli gets an invite, and Sam and Bo are both helping with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, I’ll make sure Uli gets an invite, and Bo’s on the list too. Mara’s helping spread the word and checking what tools she can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so Bo’s helping and Mara’s handling word and tools? Just checking — Sam’s still helping too, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard Gus is bringing the tools over, and Bo’s got some hand tools and gloves too. Tess is spreading the word about Saturday volunteers and the tool list, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, I’ll be there for the repair drive. It helps to know the tools are covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, that should make things a lot smoother. I’ll keep an ear out for any more updates and let you know if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep in touch and pass along any updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. Just send the updates when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll pass along any new repair drive updates as soon as I hear them.
